entries.0edbb0bab2e3312b: This business sells various semiconductors such as analog ICs, memory ICs, microprocessors, application-specific ICs and custom ICs, as well as electronic components such as crystal units, connectors and passive components. In addition to the company, sales are made mainly in Asia by sales companies in Singapore and Hong Kong under Marubun/Arrow Asia,Ltd., a joint venture equally owned with Arrow Electronics,Inc. of the United States, and by Marubun Taiwan,Inc. in Taiwan, among others. entries.12a9be71605f7107: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales to external customers were ¥152,245 million in the Device Business, about 7 tenths of the total, ¥58,623 million in the System Business and ¥2,556 million in the Entrepreneur Business. The company sells these products, and FORESIGHT TECHNO CO., LTD. provides maintenance and technical services for ICT solutions. Previously named the "Solution Business," the business was renamed in the fiscal year ended March 2026, when it transferred some businesses that had been included in the former Device Business and changed its name. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 2,556 million yen.
entries.6f29fca8085c5f5a: Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥213,425 million, up 1.2% from ¥210,837 million in the previous fiscal year. By segment, the Device Business had ¥152,245 million, the System Business ¥58,623 million, and the Entrepreneur Business ¥2,556 million. Demand for mobility and consumer equipment offset weak demand for industrial equipment, and in the System Business, demand related to artificial satellites grew significantly.
